text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Mile CS. Today, not only 
Daiichi Ruby, but also Daitaku Helios is 
racing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her rivals are like head winds blocking 
Yamanin Zephyr's path. Yet, as long as she 
continues to be the strongest wind 
herself, she should be able to surpass 
them all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She is ready. Igniting her soul to run her 
absolute best, she heads into the race 
full of fighting spirit.
